Written in faded ink was not a desperate plea from a marooned sailor, but an intricate map of the very reef beneath his boots, with a sharp black cross marked directly beneath the lighthouse foundation.", "w02": "凌晨四点，整座城市沉入最深邃的静谧。薄雾在路灯下晕开微黄的光圈，空旷的长街延伸至幽暗尽头。白日喧嚣的高楼尽数熄灯，仅剩零星窗口透出微弱的光斑。偶尔一辆环卫洒水车低鸣着驶过，水流刷洗路面的声响在寂静中格外清晰。夜归的人裹紧风衣，呼出的白雾转瞬消散，整座城都在沉睡中静待黎明破晓。", "w03": "• Recursion is like placing two mirrors facing each other: you see smaller and smaller reflections of yourself going on forever.\n• In computer science, it means solving a large problem by having a rule call itself to solve a tinier piece of the exact same problem.\n• It always includes a stop sign called a base case, which tells the program when the puzzle is small enough to finish without calling itself again."}
